candidate_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName:'Samsung'})
MATCH (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(:WorkItem {workItemCode:'NR_Mob_enh2-Core'})
MATCH (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting)
RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, tdocNumber ASC
